sunset.title: MarkdownUtil has reached end of life
sunset.ciHint: MarkdownUtil has reached end of life and is replaced by mdu. This notice fails the build on purpose so the migration cannot be missed. Replace the tool with: dotnet tool uninstall --global MarkdownUtil && dotnet tool install --global mdu (use --local and a tool manifest instead when the project uses one). We apologize for the disruption. Details: https://github.com/capjan/mdu
lines: The MarkdownUtil package is no longer maintained. The mdu command is now provided by the mdu package.
This notice replaces the tool on purpose. Pipelines that run mdu now fail with exit code 1 so the migration is visible. We apologize for the inconvenience.
In a project with a tool manifest, use: dotnet tool uninstall MarkdownUtil, then dotnet tool install mdu.
